same Claude Code. same tasks. 60% less time, 42% fewer tokens.

1 free tool stopped it from re-reading your repo on every run.

it's called Graft. it maps your codebase once into a graph of plain-English notes, committed right into your repo, 1 node per system, API, or concept, https://t.co/8UQpM7lkYY

a cheaper agent still needs a clear brief, though. it can read your repo perfectly and still ship the wrong change. here's how to actually direct AI agents:

https://t.co/FTrr6nlMQN

the bottleneck was never the model reading your code. it was reading it 100 times.

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you're running coding agents and want them fast, cheap, and actually oriented.

冷知识：

目前 dots3-note preview 的 API 是限时免费的。

但是限流：

RPM 20次/分钟，TPM 500,000 tokens/分钟。

适合长程任务，放一晚上跑的这种。

注意不应该拿来 sft ，而应该拿来 dpo ，

应该学习‘挖掘漏洞的思路’，或者拿来蒸馏 教师模型 的漏洞挖掘思路 ，做 DPO ，

而不是直接背答案。

10000道高质量人工标注的题如果都能把思路搞对，在网络安全方面，这个模型肯定是世界一流的模型。
